description_excerpt: We offer you an Ocean of Possibilities. Join our family. JOB CONTEXT Damen Song Cam Shipyard is engineering, outfitting, commissioning and delivering various Damen standard ship types. Basic designs and most components are delivered to DSCS by Damen Shipyards Gorinchem. DSCS will complete the detailed design, and production information, which will be used during the assembly of the vessels. The Quality Control (QC) department is securing quality in a way that supports maximum efficiency of the production activity. QC is an important initiator of product and process improvements.
